repairs.before: Application setup used the browser localhost origin while the email worker used APPLICATION_URL. Graph rejected subscription validation.
repairs.after: Both application helpers honor APPLICATION_URL after NGROK_URL, matching the worker. The isolated HTTPS proxy forwards the exact mailbox callback route.

repairs.before: Selecting Microsoft enabled dependent controls before the returned mailbox configuration arrived; sender saves failed mailboxRequired.
repairs.after: Provider changes and dependent outbound saves are serialized through disabled controls, with recovery after failure.

repairs.before: The real email worker retried GET /me/mailFolders/inbox with 404; messages lacked parentFolderId.
repairs.after: Inbox name/opaque ID lookups, parent metadata, unknown-folder errors and MIME download execute through the real adapter.

repairs.before: The draft expected contact attribution for MIME without authentication results. The application correctly withheld contact identity.
repairs.after: Explicit optional authentication results are preserved in downloaded MIME. Default mail remains unverified; control input rejects extra header lines.

repairs.before: Refresh replaced granted send permission with read-only defaults; initial resource-qualified scopes also leaked into scp claims and failed the application consent check.
repairs.after: Graph permission names are normalized in issued access tokens and the granted scope is retained through refresh. Application consent checks remain unchanged.

repairs.before: sendMail returned 202 but discarded text/plain base64 MIME bodies, leaving an empty captured payload.
repairs.after: Both sendMail routes parse text/plain MIME; the actual adapter smoke test verifies exact captured bytes and the browser harness parses recipient and body with mailparser.

diagnosticBrowser.scope: OAuth, webhook ticket/contact creation, UI reply, expired token refresh, decoded MIME recipient/body, callback replay and reopened UI

limits: F034 remains false; the Microsoft journeys require execution on newly built CE/EE candidates containing the application repairs.

The passing diagnostic browser used published 9b12c5 plus current emulator, NGROK_URL workaround and a temporary response wait. The checked-in journey has no response wait; remove the local NGROK_URL workaround when installing the new application candidate.
Only one authorized mailbox and Inbox are modeled. Real delivery, Exchange Send As permission and provider parity are not established.
Calendar browser coverage and bundled handler identity stability remain to be verified in the actual production build.
